title: Lue Elizondo's superiors who saw the phenomenon as demonic

tellings.quote: think in in Lou's book I found the part where he talks about some of his superiors where they had this demonic

plain: Some of the bosses of Luis Elizondo, a man who worked in a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, are said to have seen the UFO phenomenon as demonic. The account comes from a former nuclear security guard named Mario Woods, who says he found the passage in Elizondo's own book: "I found the part where he talks about some of his superiors where they had this demonic" view. If true, it would mean that people high in the Pentagon read the phenomenon in religious terms.
